description: This Java class implements a device connection service using Infinispan cache for storing device connection data. It manages cache lifecycle, provides methods for setting and retrieving last known gateways for devices, and includes health check functionalities.

classes.name: RemoteCacheBasedDeviceConnectionService
classes.description: An implementation of a device connection service that uses an Infinispan cache for storing and retrieving device connection data, managing lifecycle and health checks.

methods.name: setCacheManager
methods.description: Sets the cache manager used for retrieving the cache; throws NullPointerException if null.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Initializes and starts the cache manager and cache during service startup.

methods.name: doStop
methods.description: Stops the cache manager and cleans up during service shutdown.

methods.name: setLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Stores the last known gateway ID for a device in the cache asynchronously.

methods.name: getLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the last known gateway ID for a device asynchronously.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Constructs the cache key for a device based on tenant and device ID.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Returns the device connection service instance.

methods.name: registerReadinessChecks
methods.description: Registers health check for cache readiness.

methods.name: registerLivenessChecks
methods.description: Registers health check for cache liveness.

methods.name: checkForCacheAvailability
methods.description: Performs a health check by verifying if the cache is available.
